title: LeanContext: Disentangling Mathematical Resources from Local Formal Context in Lean Whole-Proof Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.08277v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural theorem proving increasingly uses retrieved premises and project context to support proof generation. Evaluating these resources requires measuring the advantage of target-selected declarations over comparable alternatives and how this advantage depends on training. We introduce LeanContext, a benchmark of 129,826 Lean whole-proof generation problems, to investigate these questions. We group selected complete preceding mathematical declarations as Mathematical Context (MC) and the remaining selected local source commands as Environment Context (EC). Four aligned input views support crossed training and inference evaluations with shared targets and original Lean verification environments. For both diffusion- and autoregressive-based models, selected declarations outperform comparable alternatives by a larger margin when training includes MC. translated_title: LeanContext：在Lean整段证明生成中将数学资源与局部形式化上下文解耦
translated_abstract: 神经定理证明越来越多地使用检索到的前提和项目上下文来辅助证明生成。评估这些资源需要衡量目标所选声明相对于可比替代方案的优势，以及这种优势如何依赖于训练。我们引入了LeanContext——一个包含129,826个Lean整段证明生成问题的基准——来研究这些问题。我们将所选的完整前置数学声明归为数学上下文，将剩余所选的局部源码命令归为环境上下文。四种对齐的输入视图支持在共享目标和原始Lean验证环境下的交叉训练与推理评估。对于基于扩散和基于自回归的模型，当训练包含数学上下文时，所选声明相对于可比替代方案表现出更大的优势。最终输入审计能够识别出目标所引用但被遗漏的声明。优先考虑……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出包含129,826个Lean整段证明生成问题的基准LeanContext，通过将数学上下文与环境上下文解耦，发现当训练数据包含数学上下文时，模型才能更大程度地利用目标所选声明相对于可比替代方案的优势。
en_tdlr: LeanContext, a benchmark of 129,826 Lean whole-proof generation problems, disentangles Mathematical Context from Environment Context and shows that selected declarations yield a larger advantage over comparable alternatives when Mathematical Context is included in training.
